  CANCELLATION OF REGULAR MEETING OF THE
  PARKS & RECREATION COMMISSION

 NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the Regular Meeting of the City
  of South Gate Parks & Recreation Commission scheduled for
  Thursday, January 8, 2026 at 7:00 p.m. has been cancelled.

  The next Regular meeting will be February 12, 2026.

  City Hall Council Chambers, 8650 California Avenue, South Gate CA 90280
